name: Team lineup
pitch: Find the most likely starting eleven for tomorrow's match and explain the choices.
instructions: Search for the team's next match and starting lineup. Look at recent match reports, the official club website, and reputable sports news sites. Note injuries, suspensions and tactical changes. Summarise the most probable starting eleven and give one or two reasons for each selection. If the lineup cannot be found, say so and offer to check a different source or the next match.

examples.does: search for the team's next match and list the likely starters with reasons
find the probable eleven and explain the tactical choices

examples.ask: who starts for my team tomorrow
examples.does: look up the team and give the most likely lineup with brief reasons

readme:
# Team lineup
Find the most likely starting eleven for tomorrow's match and explain the choices.

Works with any professional team. Needs only web search. Will not place bets, send messages or sign up for anything.

If the lineup cannot be found, the agent will say so and offer to check a different source or the next match.
